name: Shield Brace

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: This armor contains a slot for a shield to be integrated into one arm. It takes 10 minutes of work to install or remove a shield from this slot. The shield must have the compact or retractable trait and gains the installed trait as long as it's installed in your armor. A shield fitted this way doesn't take up your hand, so you can Raise a Shield with it if the hand is free or if it's holding a light object. Unlike a compact shield, you can still Raise a Shield fitted this way even if the hand is wielding a light weapon.
